name: Moose
notes: Adult moose broadside. The heart–lung area is larger than 30 cm; the zone is kept smaller for a margin. Energy is a common guideline at the animal, not a law.

name: Red deer
notes: Stag or hind broadside. Energy is a common guideline at the animal, not a law.

name: Elk (wapiti)
notes: North American elk broadside. 2000 J is the often quoted 1500 ft·lbf at the animal; a guideline, not a law.

name: Fallow deer
notes: Buck or doe broadside. Energy is a common guideline at the animal, not a law.

name: White-tailed deer
notes: Broadside. 20 cm is the familiar 8-inch vital zone; 1350 J is the often quoted 1000 ft·lbf. Guidelines, not law.

name: Roe deer
notes: Buck or doe broadside. Energy is a guideline at the animal, not a law.

name: Wild boar
notes: Adult boar broadside; the vitals sit low and well forward, behind the front leg. Energy is a guideline, not a law.

name: Brown bear
notes: Adult bear broadside. Energy is a guideline at the animal, not a law.

name: Red fox
notes: Broadside. A rough guideline for small game; follow your bullet maker's expansion data.

name: Mountain hare
notes: Crouched broadside; height to the back. The zone is the chest. Small-game energy is a rough guideline: placement matters most. No expansion velocity is asked for.

name: Rabbit
notes: Crouched broadside; height to the back. The zone is the chest. Small-game energy is a rough guideline: placement matters most. No expansion velocity is asked for.

name: Capercaillie
notes: Cock broadside; height to the back, length beak to tail. Often shot in trees; drawn on the ground. The zone is the chest. Energy is a rough guideline; check which calibres your country allows for birds.

name: Black grouse
notes: Cock broadside; height to the back, length beak to tail. Often shot in trees; drawn on the ground. The zone is the chest. Energy is a rough guideline; check which calibres your country allows for birds.

name: Ptarmigan
notes: Willow or rock ptarmigan broadside; height to the back, length beak to tail. The zone is the chest. Energy is a rough guideline; check which calibres your country allows for birds.

name: ISSF 300 m rifle target
notes: 10 ring 100 mm, 1 ring 1000 mm. The hit zone is the 600 mm black (rings 5–10).

name: ISSF 50 m rifle target
notes: 10 ring 10.4 mm, 1 ring 154.4 mm. The hit zone is the 112.4 mm black (rings 4–10).

name: ISSF 10 m air rifle target
notes: 10 ring 0.5 mm (a dot), 1 ring 45.5 mm. The hit zone is the 30.5 mm black (rings 4–9).

name: Steel plate 10 cm
notes: Round gong. Keep the plate maker's minimum distance for your cartridge.

name: Steel plate 20 cm
notes: Round gong, about 8 inches. Keep the plate maker's minimum distance for your cartridge.

name: Steel plate 30 cm
notes: Round gong, about 12 inches. Keep the plate maker's minimum distance for your cartridge.
